summary: Kootenai NF lookout site in Lincoln County, MT: a 1940 60-foot pole tower that was never built, a 6x6 ft frame cab; listed gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 6-by-6-foot frame cab on a ground site; a 60-foot pole tower was never built
facts.status_note: Listed gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; firelookout.com says abandoned. No source describes what remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Only one source gives any history (firelookout.com, author credit Rex Kamstra): the 1940 entry, the never-built 60-foot pole tower and the frame cab. The page's phrase 'still there' is read as belonging to the 1940 entry; no source dates the cab. Status conflict is unresolved: the FFLA list says Gone, firelookout.com says Abandoned; the story reports both. Do not confuse with Warland Peak lookout, a separate standing NHLR site (US 1506). The 1939-1945 Warland Ranger Station memoir in the cache (Early Days vol. 4) is about the station and mentions only Warland Peak lookout, so it is not cited. No source describes today's condition, access or any photo. Record status 'gone' matches the FFLA row; no correction.
